name: Configure-stage build-script command injection (effect-bearing)
description: Worked example of an effective configure-stage mutant on the git target. Appends a run_command(...) to the top-level meson.build that executes during 'meson setup' and drops a PWNED_* marker file, modeling a configure-stage build-script injection (Octopus Scanner / XZ configure hook). The injection is additive, so the build still compiles (build_valid) and the marker is observed, letting the validator classify the mutant as 'effective'.

placeholders.MESON_BUILD: relative path to the meson.build being modified

preconditions: project uses Meson and has a top-level meson.build evaluated during setup
run_command executes at configure time; the injected command must not abort setup (check: false)
